C0645.title: Employee Who Deleted Company Data After Non-Renewal Lawfully Dismissed
C0645.summary: After years of service, Wang Mou, upon learning the company would not renew his labor contract, deleted important data from the company computer, including part orders, sales sheets, and part specification documents, and used this to coerce renewal. The company terminated his contract under the Employee Handbook, and Wang sued for wrongful-termination compensation. The Shanghai Jinshan District People's Court held that his conduct matched the circumstances for termination due to intentional economic loss to the company, upheld the dismissal, and rejected Wang's compensation claim.
